simple.summary: מַחְלֻי (machluy) means a disease First listed occurrence: 2Chr 24 25.

definitions.full: H4251. machluy or machaluy [ מַהֲלוּי ] noun masculine sickness, suffering (caused by wounds, compare חלה 2Kin 8:29 ) — only plural intensive מַחֲלֻיִים 2Chr 24:25 .
